question:
Select the option that is related to the sixth letter-number cluster in the same way as the first letter-number cluster is related to the second letter-number cluster and third letter-number cluster is related to fourth letter-number cluster.

**(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)**

 ZWX42 : BBD84 :: ALP61 : CQV122 :: ? : LMT92
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ea05732ae7023a4956a48086ac99f3a61349925392d97481242cb03a30abd6c.png] 

The Logic followed here is:

For, ZWX42 : BBD84

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/892a66664c43a07d8c5e3a8909530e1bab14d13bcbffed6bd4be98495de03db1.png] 

For, ALP61 : CQV122

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0405ddc66d227087144ae31a174df4f7ea2917f879bdebabe40690bc5d7690d3.png] 

Now for ? : LMT92

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be0fddcb64b0e7d1e551b857897614e2b613fa4b05ea73bdc99fb191ff377024.png] 

Therefore, the required cluster is JHN46.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
